class cccma_ppp.core.trainer.TrainerConfig(beta_finder=None, earlystoppingbuffer=inf, minimum_validation_improvement_percentage=0.02, gradient_accumulation_steps=1, mixed_precision=True, grad_clip=None)[source]

Bases: object

Training configuration controlling loop behavior.

Parameters:

  • beta_finder (BetaAnnealing | None) – Beta annealing schedule for KL divergence (used in cVAE training).

  • earlystoppingbuffer (float) – Number of epochs allowed without improvement before stopping.

  • minimum_validation_improvement_percentage (float) – Minimum relative improvement required to reset early stopping counter.

  • gradient_accumulation_steps (int) – Number of steps to accumulate gradients before optimizer update.

  • mixed_precision (bool) – Whether to use mixed precision training.

  • grad_clip (float | None) – Maximum gradient norm for clipping.
